provenance_note: Two-step pattern. A closure record cannot name its own containing commit. Content commit C finalises the deliverables; closure commit D then records evidence_content_commit=C and the hashes read from C. Until D exists this field is null and the hashes describe the working tree. A previous version claimed the pre-PR base commit, which could not contain the artefacts it bound.
